text:
incident-bot: Pager: cont-batch latency spike & KV-prefetch blowup in prod-us-east-1. Alert: tail p95 > 1200ms, KV cache size rising rapidly. Pager oncall: @priya

alex: oncall alert seen, standing by. can you link runbook?

priya: I'm oncall. grabbing logs and telemetry. quick plan: throttle prefetch, reduce continuous_batch.window_ms, cap microbatch tokens, and apply temporary traffic limits for the affected pool. will post commands.

jamie: telemetry confirms microbatch size jumped to ~64 in the last 5m. KV evictions and write amplification spiking. looks like prefix cache thrash.

megan: getting SLO noise from vip-customer-42 (prod). 5 requests 502/504 and several high-latency reports. CSM looped in.

priya: executing mitigations now. steps: 1) patch controller config to drop window_ms to 10ms and microbatch_max_tokens to 8. 2) add temporary route concurrency cap for model-prod v3. 3) if no improvement, roll restart nodes in nodepool-kv-2 to clear local caches.

alex: paste the exact commands when you run them so I can replicate for other regions.

priya: running patch:
```bash
kubectl -n inference patch configmap continuous-batching --type merge -p '{"data":{"window_ms":"10","microbatch_max_tokens":"8"}}'
```
also throttling route:
```bash
rwctl routes update --route model-prod --concurrency 200
```

opsbot: configmap patched by priya (user:priya) at 1785551242

jamie: telemetry: avg microbatch size dropped to ~9, queue length down ~60% within 30s. good signal.

priya: KV cache growth slowed but not fully stopped. eviction rate stabilized. p95 latency dropping from 1300ms -> 420ms. continuing to monitor.

megan: CSM: VIP reports improved latency on recheck. I'll send a brief customer update in 30m after stabilization.

ben: can we flip prefetch off for the affected shard to prevent further cache amplification?

priya: applying prefetch toggle to shard kv-shard-9:
```bash
rwctl pool update kv-shard-9 --set prefetch.enabled=false
```
done at 1785551260

opsbot: pool updated by priya at 1785551261

jamie: nice — write amplification dropped, eviction rate down ~80% over 2m. throughput recovering.

priya: keeping mitigations in place for 15m then we'll attempt gradual re-enable with lower fanout. if stable, we'll roll the hotfix with a canary and follow changelog. otherwise prepare for node restarts.

alex: handing off to next oncall @ben in 20m. I'll update the incident doc with timeline and perf graphs. :white_check_mark:

ben: ack, I'll monitor for 2h. please capture customer impact + exact mitigation timestamps.

priya: postmortem notes (wip): root cause hypothesis — prefetch heuristic overestimated prefix hotness under very high concurrency and large microbatching, resulting in KV cache blowout and oversized microbatches. That caused queueing and p95 latency cliffs. Immediate mitigations: prefetch throttle, microbatch cap, and route concurrency cap. Follow-ups: add guardrail to prevent microbatch >16 tokens under high concurrency, telemetry alert for KV growth rate and microbatch size distribution, and a safe rollback path for the prefetch heuristic.

incident-bot: Incident annotated as 'mitigated' by priya at 1785551307. Pager cleared.
